x: Two temporary visitors to Belgrave, American Olympic athletes Goertz Klopfer and Tom Dooley, have made many friends as well as producing some really great performances - its as well for the other clubs that they are not staying longer !

In the closing stages Goertz Klopfer USA and Belgrave overtook Ray just failing to catch Lightman in the last 200 yards. Len Duquemin and John Moullin walked steady, well-judged races, gaining valuable places as the race went on.
The B squad were led by Goertz Klopfer and it was he who won the first stage with Stapleford of Leicester hanging on grimly to lead John Moullin by some 85 second.
From the U.S.A. we had Gertz Klopfer (placed in London to Brighton Walk) and Tom Dooley and from 'down under' came two "Aussies" Dave de Bondi and Alan Lucas.
